title: And This is Love
speaker: Pastor Tito Lyro

outline.title: The Test of Genuine Faith
subpoints: Love for the brethren as evidence of salvation

outline.title: The Basis of Christian Love
subpoints: Love is rooted in God's prior love

outline.title: The Pattern of Love
subpoints: Christ laid down His life willingly
The Cross removes barriers to fellowship with the Father

outline.title: Two Families in the World
subpoints: Children of God vs. Children of the Devil
The visible church contains both wheat and tares
Cain as the prototype of the unloving

summary:
In this sermon, Pastor Tito Lyro explores the nature of genuine Christian love as presented in 1 John 3:10-18. He emphasizes that love for the brethren is not merely an emotional sentiment but a definitive marker of true faith, distinguishing the children of God from the children of the devil. The message counters the notion that assurance of salvation requires secret knowledge, asserting instead that belief, obedience, and love are accessible tests for every believer.

The pastor highlights that the basis for Christian love is divine love, specifically the sacrificial death of Jesus Christ. By laying down His life, Christ not only enables believers to love but also provides the pattern for how they should love. This sacrificial love is described as a propitiation that removes the barrier of sin, allowing believers to have secure fellowship with God.

Furthermore, the sermon addresses the reality of the visible church, noting that it contains both true believers and those who do not genuinely follow Christ. Using the parable of the wheat and tares, the message encourages self-examination regarding one's faith, urging believers to ensure their lives reflect the righteousness and love that characterize true discipleship.
